Principles.intro: Four principles that make every DharmaDeha a safe place to grow.

principles.title: Confidentiality
principles.body: What we share in the group stays within the group.

principles.title: Carefulness
principles.body: We speak from our own perspective — without judgment, debate, or unsolicited advice. Every voice is equal.

principles.title: Voluntariness
principles.body: You participate according to your state — you can speak or simply say 'pass'.

principles.title: Engagement
principles.body: We show up regularly, give advance notice when we can't attend, and participate in collective meditations.

items.q: How much time does it take per week?
items.a: One weekly meeting of about 80 minutes, plus 15–30 minutes of self-study before each session. Around 95–110 minutes in total.
Yes, fully free. We operate on a voluntary basis. If DharmaDeha brings value to your life, you are welcome to support the project through a donation — but this is never required.

items.q: What is the duration of a DharmaDeha?
items.a: One cycle of a DharmaDeha corresponds to one course — 7 or 10 sessions. After finishing, participants can continue with another course or take a break.

items.q: What language are the meetings in?
items.a: English, Russian, Ukrainian, and Italian. When you apply, you choose your preferred language and are placed in a matching group.

items.q: Do I need to be initiated in Ananda Marga?
items.a: No. Most participants are initiated, but DharmaDeha is open to anyone sincere on a spiritual path.

items.q: What if I miss a meeting?
items.a: Life happens. Please let your mentor know in advance. You can catch up by reading the lesson material. Missing too many sessions may mean completing the course in the next cycle.

items.q: Are DharmaDehas online or in person?
items.a: Most DharmaDehas meet online via Zoom. In some cities, in-person groups exist or are forming — ask when you apply.
Click the 'Join a DharmaDeha' button, fill in a short form with your preferred language, course, and availability. We'll match you with a group within 1–2 weeks.

FinalCTA.body: Join for free. No prior experience required. Just bring your practice and sincerity.
